step1Body: HTTPS auditing needs this certificate. Run on your machine:
howItWorksIntro: CiCy Audit is a transparent HTTPS proxy that sits between your AI tools and each provider's API.
howItWorksDiagram: Your AI tools → CiCy Audit proxy → AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, ...)
howItWorksProviders: Supported providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google (Gemini), DeepSeek, Qwen, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock.
instInstallCert: Install the CA certificate first (see step 1)
instRunAsUsual: Run your AI tools as usual — all traffic is audited automatically
